note: Written by hand after looking at the pages named here; the scripts read this file and carry it into summary.json. Both checks look at the corpus PDFs themselves, so they hold for any run on AIDP-2K.

intake.what: The three unread pages that have no text layer (rasterised heavy-noise pages), rendered from the PDFs into the crops listed.

pages.seen: the closing line "毎度ありがとうございます。", its top cut by the page break, a page crease and the footer's rule; nothing else
the closing line "Merci de votre confiance.", its top cut by the page break, a crease and the footer's rule; nothing else
the closing line "Thank you for your business.", its top cut by the page break, a crease and the footer's rule; nothing else

intake.verdict: None of the three is blank: each holds only the document's closing line, which no answer-key field holds. With the 19 text-layer pages, all 22 unread pages hold the closing line and nothing else.

sticker_geometry.seen: the first sticker covers the header row only; row 1 is whole. Testing the corners of each character's box would mark row 1's quantity, unit and price as covered, because the box reaches above the ink; the test uses points inside the ink, which leaves row 1 judged, as the page shows.

two stickers over rows 99 to 104; the computed covered cells match the page row by row (99: quantity, unit, price; 100: spec to price; 101: spec, lot, serial, the serial losing its top to the sticker's edge; 102: unit and price; 103: spec to price; 104: spec). Row 104's lot loses only the very top of its characters, is still legible and is judged.
covered cells computed for rows 3, 4, 7, 8 and 9 (price and amount; lot to amount; serial; article to lot; article to spec) match the stickers on the page; rows 1, 2, 5, 6 and 10 are whole.

reading_order.sample: The reading-order verdicts themselves are the scripts' own and were not checked by eye here. node aidp-bench/bench/post-run/by-eye.mjs --corpus <AIDP-2K folder> prints a seeded sample of them, each row beside the reading's lines, for anyone who wants to.

stamps.verdict: Not checked by eye: the generator's draw was confirmed on every PDF by two independent machine checks (the stamp's rotated text in the 1,698 PDFs with a text layer; the stamp's colour in solid areas on every page of the 302 rasterised PDFs), and the colour detector agreed with the text layer on page 1 of all 1,698.
